resources.string: Choose ClockMorph designs for two rows. Replaces the device info widgets while enabled.
Soften the wallpaper behind widget cards
Choose widgets for either row to get started
Small widgets use one slot, wide widgets use two, and inline widgets fill a row. Remove a widget before reducing a full row from five slots to four.
Tap a design to add it to this row. Tap a selected design to remove it. Designs that do not fit are dimmed.
